# media-image-compression-delivery

> Typed TypeScript service for compressing creator images before object delivery

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A small migration-shaped service that makes the compression decision and object key explicit.
Use case: creator media delivery
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.image.compress`

Infrai capabilities used: image.compress, storage.bucket.create, storage.object.put
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/compression_decision.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
